aggregation: mean of native elevations (no MOLA offset applied); NaN if any contributor is unknown
layout: row-major from the north-west corner of each tile
subsamples_per_cell: 5x5 points per app cell, each mapped to its nearest native 1 m pixel
source: MRO HiRISE DEM 1 m, set 1029 (esp_051762_1750_esp_050918_1750_tied-dem.tif), Day et al. 2023
